cases.scenario: A resource API accepts an app-only fixture as if it carried the required delegated user authority.
cases.expected_decision: Confirm the contract and actual protected operation; separate handler simulation from real token validation.

cases.scenario: A registration requests a permission, but it is not consented/granted and the API denies use.
cases.expected_decision: Do not report the request itself as obtained resource authority.

cases.scenario: A test uses an administrator who deliberately consented broad access in their own tenant.
cases.expected_decision: Do not infer another tenant was compromised without a separate trust-boundary failure.
